metadata.title: Headingley 2019: The 135* (Stokes Miracle)
metadata.text:
MIRACLE OF HEADINGLY

INTRODUCTION

23 August 2019, Ashes ke teesre test ka dusra din.

Headingly mein ho raha woh match ek normal match sa lag raha tha. Us din pe aaya hua English Crowd was happy kyuki England ne already Australia ko pehli innings mein 179 pe all out kar diya tha. But jaha pe England ke players and fans pe confidence pe tha wahi pe Australia ke players ne kuch umeed jagah di thi kyuki England bhi 24/3 thi din ki shuruwaat se pehle. Woh din shuru hota hai, aur pure stadium mein bas ek hi fanbase chilla raha tha, kyuki jitni tagdi us Ashes ka level tha, utni hi tagdi Australia ki bowling bhi thi. Lunch khatam hota hai aur England already 67 pe hi all out ho chuki thi . Aakhri din aate aate England woh almost haanre wali thi jab 4th innings mein world champions England ko 73 runs aur chaihye the aur ba 1 wicket aur chaihye tha. England toh chood even Australia ko bhi beleive nahi ho raha tha ki ek host team etna bekar kaise khel sakti hai. Ek woh din tha aur ek aaj ka din tha ki jo us test match ke baad hua woh aaj bhi test cricket ke itihaas mein baar baar repeat karaya jaata hai. Yeh baat hai us iconic test knock jisne us match ko nahi balki us infamous Australia vs England rivalry ko wapas se iconic bana diya. Yeh baat hai tabki jab hame Benjamin Stokes ka 2nd name pata chala tha - CLUTH !!!!!!

metadata.title: Headingley 2019: The 135* (Stokes Miracle)
metadata.text:
PRE MATCH SCENARIO

Ab agar hum us match se pehle ke scenario ki baat karein, toh situation England ke liye utni achhi nahi thi jitni log soch rahe the. England aur english cricket ke liye sabse iconic event ho chuka tha jab kuch mahino pehle woh ek dramatic manner mein 2019 ka world cup jeet ke aa rahi thi. England ke itishaas ka pehla world cup aur us team ka confidence maano aasman choo raha tha. But as we all know jaha baat aati hai test cricket ki………My friend anything can happen in the deadliest format of the game. Aur jab saamne ho Australia and dau pe ashes ki trophy lagi ho toh pressure aana toh laazmi hai..

Australia, jinke top players Steve Smith aur David Warner sandpaper bans ke baad wapas aaye the, unka focus sirf ek cheez pe tha — Ashes jeetna. Kyuki jitna critism unhone pichle ek saal mein jhela hai , even is tour ke starting mein bhi jis tarike se English fan unhe boo karne wale the aur smith ko sandpaper dikhake disrespect karne wale the. English fans had no idea ki woh kin players ko uksa rahe hai. Because initial tests mein Smith no England ke saath kiya hai, woh fans ko regret hi nahi balki ek liflong trauma mein daal deta hai.

Pehla Test Edgbaston mein hua jaha Steve Smith ne apne comeback pe 144 runs ki ek shandaar paari kheli aur England ke bowlers ko poora thaka diya.

James Anderson, jo England ke sabse senior bowler the, match ke first day pe hi injured ho gaye the, jiski vajah se yeh series ab England ke liye aur mushkil hote hue dikh rahi thi. Is injury ne England ke bowling attack ko kaafi weak kar diya. Australia ne woh Test jeet kar 1-0 ki lead le li jisme Smith ne ek aur baar 2nd inning mein century lagai. World cup winning side ab bas Steve Smith ke redemption ka shikaar bante hue nazar aa rahi thi. Jitni umeed fans ne World champions england se lagai thi , woh saari first test ke baad badalti hui dikh rahi thi.

Doosra Test Lord’s mein tha and it was no different . Steve Smith aur Marnus Labuchagne ne na keval ek sustaibale innings kheli, but us match ko jo Australia almost haarne wali thi use draw kara diya. England ke batting line-up, specially top order, poore series mein struggle kar rahe the. Jason Roy, Joe Denly, aur Rory Burns consistent runs nahi bana pa rahe the. Jaha pe ek taraf Joe Denly aur Rory Burns ne proper 20 test matches bhi nahi khele the , vahi pe hamare white ball specialist Jason roy ki toh yeh pehli series thi.

Lekin phir series ka aata hai teesra Test Match. Headingley Leeds !

Ek match jisne us puri Ashes ko hi nahi balki Modern Ashes ke complete legacy ko hi redifine karke rakh diya tha. Jise execute karne wale aur koi nahi balki 2019 world cup final ke hero Ben stokes the.

Series ka third Test Headingley (Leeds) mein hona tha — aur yahaan England ke paas ek hi option tha, jeet. Agar woh match haar jaate, toh Australia 2-0 se aage jaata aur Ashes unke haath se nikal jaati. Pressure obviously bahut zyada tha. Team ke andar bhi sabko pata tha ki agar yeh match haara toh criticism aur badega.

metadata.title: Headingley 2019: The 135* (Stokes Miracle)
metadata.text:
Is time pe Ben Stokes ke upar sabse zyada expectation thi. World Cup final ke baad unka image ek “national hero” jaisa ban gaya tha. Lekin Test cricket mein woh form continue kar paayenge ya nahi, yeh sabko dekhna tha. Dressing room ke andar bhi Ben Stokes sabse focused player dikh rahe the. Reports ke mutabiq woh apne practice sessions mein sabse last tak nets mein rehete the, aur poora concentration red-ball game pe shift kar rahe the.

Australia ki team ke paas ek solid pace attack tha — Cummins, Hazlewood, aur Pattinson. Saath hi Labuschagne ne Smith ki jagah perfectly fill kar di thi.

Team ka confidence peak pe tha.

22 August 2019 ko jab Headingley Test start hua, tab dono teams ek alag mindset ke saath utari. Australia ke liye yeh ek mauka tha Ashes retain karne ka, aur England ke liye apni izzat bachane ka.

Match ke pehle hi day pe conditions cloudy thi, aur Headingley ka pitch seamers ke liye perfect tha. Australia ne toss jeet kar batting choose ki, aur England ne early wickets lene ki puri koshish kari. Jofra Archer ne phenomenal bowling karte hue Australia ko 179 pe all-out kar diya. Lekin jaha sabko laga ki ab England easy lead le lega, wahi team pehli innings mein sirf 67 pe all-out ho gayi.

Is moment ke baad pure England dressing room mein silence tha. Fans, experts, sabko lag raha tha ki yeh Test match ab haath se gaya. But a certain innings was about to come from a certain player….or NOT !

metadata.title: Headingley 2019: The 135* (Stokes Miracle)
metadata.text:
THE INNINGS !

Us match mein kuch important ho ya na ho lekin England ke recently bane world cup star “Ben Stokes” ka chalna behad hi zaruri tha. Agar 2 matches ki disappointment ke baad kisi player pe ashaaye lagaye jaa rahi thi, toh woh keval Ben stokes hi the. Aur maano agle match hi woh English fans ki umeedo par khade utre aur aisa perform kara, ki aaj tak bhi us performance ki baat karte log nahi thakte.

Toh kahaani ki shuruwaat hoti hai 22 August 2019 se, Ashes ka teesra test match aur Headingley (LEEDS) ke us ground pe dono teams test match khelne utarti hai. Jaha pe Australia lead ko badane ke liye match khel rahi thi, vahi England apne hi ghar par ijjat talash rahi thi. Test match ke shuru hote hi England ne underperform karna shuru kar diya aur 80% of test match mein Australia nee dominance dikhae rakha. Jaha Aus ne pehle innings mein keval 179 hi runs banai paayi thi, vahi England comeback karne ki bajaye mahez 67 runs banakar all out ho gayi. Match ka chautha din aate aate jo English crowd , England team ki comeback ki umeed kar rahe the, ab bas kai sawalon ke saath hi bache the. Aur is sab ke zimmedaar Ben stokes ko hi banae jane walla tha kyon ki surkhiyo mein toh vahi the. Agar is sab ke alawa baat kare toh England us match ko almost haar chuki thi kyunki ab unhe 4th innings match ko jeetne ke liye 359 runs chaiye the aur almost 1.5 day ka khel bacha hua tha. Agar realistically baat kare toh Is sab ke baad ya toh england match ko jeet ti ya phir direct haar ka saamna karna padta, kyon ki itna zyada time ke baad draw ka koi option hi nahi tha. Lekin England tab bhi draw ke liye khelti hai aur 77 over baad phas jaati hai. 77 over baad England ka score keval 159 hi hua tha aur 5 wicket gir chuke the. Sabko lag raha tha ki England draw ke liye khel rahi hai is haalat ko dekh kar England match toh nahi jeetne wali.

Lekin us time pe crease pe ek batsman abhi bhi khada hua tha aaur woh the “Ben stokes”. Bhale hi stadium mein baitha har ek aadmi England ki jeet ki ummede kabki chood chuka ho, Lekin Ben stokes abhi bhi jeet ke liye khel rahe the aur aisi situation mein jaha England kabhi bhi all out hoke match ko haar sakti hai. Aur yahi hame Ben Stokes ki mental toughness batati hai ki ek cricketer mentally kitna tough ho sakta hai ki jab stadium mein choodo, pure tv media yeh maanke baith chuki thi ki England is point se kabhi bhi match haar sakti hai, lekin Stokes abhi bhi jeetne ki intention se batting kar rahe the.

Match ka thrilling moment tab shuru hua jab match ke 116ve over mein Stuart Broad out ho gaye aur team ka score 286-9 ho chuka tha.

1 Wicket, bas 1 wicket aur Australia 2-0 se aage hone wali thi. Har Australian fan ab Ashes jeetne ke sapne dekh raha tha. Lekin unhe yeh nahi pata tha ki unke aur Australia ke jeet ke beech abhi bhi Ben STOKES khade hue the. Aur pressure situations mein Stokes kaisa perform karte hai, yeh hamne 2019 world cup final mein bakhubi dekha tha. Lekin jeet ke liye 72 runs aur chaiye the and sab khatam ho chuka tha.

metadata.title: Headingley 2019: The 135* (Stokes Miracle)
metadata.text:
[black screen pause]

Until hame yeh dekhne ko mila [stokes hitting 4 clip] Headingley Final Day HIGHLIGHTS! | Incredible Ben Stokes Wins Match | The Ashes Day 4 2019 Ben stokes ek end pe khade reh rehke , reh rehke run banate gaye aur itni pressure situation mein na hi keval unhone apne carrer ki best century lagai, balki England ko ek historic jeet bhi dila di. Win predictor bhi confuse ho gaya tha ki aakhir England jeet kaisi sakti hai. Lekin us clutch innings khelkar Ben stokes ne undoubtedly Test cricket ke itihaas ki greatest knock khel di. Aur tabhi se Ben stokes ko clutch player kahle jane laga. Woh knock unki itini iconic thi ki 2019 ke khatam hone ke baad unhe unke total contributions ki vajah se ICC cricketer of the year bhi chuna gaya tha Us Inning ne keval unhe world ke top all rounders mein darja diya balki yeh bata diya ki aap end tak England ya ben stokes ko discard nahi kar sakte hai.

Temperament , Discipline aur Clutch moments se bhari hui yeh inning aaj bhi Ashes ki best innings maani jati hai.

metadata.title: Hindi Broadcast Commentary Script
metadata.text:
Why Hindi Commentary sucks !!!

Intro:

[Adit watching matching and Siddhu + Akash commentary stucks in]

Nahi isse pehle aap ko ki mein konsi stand up comedy dekh raha hu…..toh yeh koi stand up comedy nahi hai.

Aur han yeh koi Muishara bhi nahi hai……Yeh actually mein cricket match hai

!!!!

Han bilkul sahi suna……Ek cricket match jise Hindi commentary mein dekhne se aisa lag raha hai ki mein koi mushaira ya phir koi stand up comedy dekh raha hu. But yeh sirf Hindi commentary ke saath hi kyu hai?

Cricket !

Ek aisa sports jo ki apne culture se jyada apne moments ke liye jaana jata hai.

Phir chahe woh koi tagda record ho ya phir India ka world cup jeet jana.. Har cricket moment jiski vajah se ek indian cricket fan banta ha…usme sabse bada haath commentary ka hota hai. Aur aisa ho bhi kyu na…..Commetators ka us live moment mein kiye gaye woh kuch shabd us moment ko kitna iconic bana dete hai woh koi bhi calculate nahi kar sakta hai.

[JUMP TO ENGLISH COMMENTARY MOMENTS ON SACHIN TENDULKAR

AND INDIA WINNING THE WORLD CUP]

Lekin aisa kyu hai ki yeh sab keval English commentary ke liye valid hai? 💔 Aur jab baat hindi commentary ki aati hai toh jis language mein ham sabse jyada comfortable hote hai usi se nafrat honi lag jati hai. Criticism se lekar hatred tak sab emotions nikal jaate hai lekin tab bhi Hindi commentary improve nahi hoti hai.

Toh aisa kyu hai ki jis desh mein cricket sabse jyada popular hai usi bhasha mein commentary sabse worst banti jaa rahi hai.

Aur kya language ki vajah se hai ya phir broadcasters aur trp laane ke liye chakkar mein Hindi commentary ko bali pe chadaya jaa raha hai !

Evolution of Cricket Commentary 📻 Ab jab Hindi commentary mein kamiya nikalni se pehle hume yeh pata hona chaihye ki aakhir commentary itni important kyu hai. Kyu aakhir log commentary ke saath cricket dekhna pasand karte hai?

Toh agar hum shuruwaat se shuru kare toh era aata hai 1920s ka….ha jab commentary ki actual shurat hui thi. Ek aisa samay jaha pe TV utne nahi the jisse jyada radios the. Aur yeh wahi era tha jab Commentary apni peak pe thi.

Kyuki jaha pe ek taraf log match ko dekh nahi sakte the vahi pe sirf english ya hindi commentary sunke pure match kon experience kar lete the. Yeh wahi time tha jise hamari generation ke fathers aur grandfathers ne commentary witness kari thi. Bowling analysis se lekar batsman ne kitni accuracy ke sath konsa shot khela, yeh sab commentary mein pata chal jata tha. Aur ise hum RADIO ERA bhi keh sakte hai.

Richie Benaud , John Arlott aur Tony Cozier jaise commentators ne us era mein raaj kiya hua tha.

metadata.title: Hindi Broadcast Commentary Script
metadata.text:
The goal was simple :

Ek cricket watcher ko cricket ka game complete tarike se samjha do….

Aur yeh kehna galat nahi hoga ki yeh goal aaj bhi valid hai.

Isliye shayad 2026 aate aate aaj ke zamane mein English commentary Hindi commentary se kafi aage nikal chuki hai.

But jaise ek famous quote hai ki “Eras come to and end”.

Vaise hi Radio era ka bhi end aaya aur early 1990s mein shuru hua Television era… And yahi woh era tha jab cricket ek passionate sport se ek paisa kamane ki machine banne wali thi…Kyuki yaha se ab cricket mein TV Brodcasters ka rise hone wala tha aur woh dominant banne wale the. Yaani commentary woh same commentary nahi rehene wali thi.

Ab majority janta tv pe matches dekh sakti thi, toh commentators in depth details se shift hokar—> tactical analysis , player psychology , storytelling , aur statsitrics pe shift ho gaye the. Jo ki apne aap mein kafi sahi baat thi. English commentary mein yeh sab elements aane ke baad commentary aur bhi logo ko appealing lagni lag gayi thi.

Arrival Of Hindi Commentary 🛕 Ab cricket aur commentary dono grow kar rahi thi, lekin ek cheez ki kami thi…Radio ke era khatam hone ke baad jo thodi bohot hindi commentary hpoti thi, television era aane ke baad woh bhi khatam ho chuki thi. Lekin as we all know 1992 ke South african series ke rights kharidne ke baad BCCI ka as a board kitna bada rise hua [Video promotionnnnnnn]. Aur aaj BCCI world ka richest board hai. Isi ke chalte early 2000s mein Star Sports , ESPN aur Sony jaise channels ne Had se jyada bani hui cricket kio lejkar hype ko dekhte hue Hindi commentary ko wapas laane ka decide kiya ! Aur yaha se shuruwat hui us commentary ki India mein jise aaj hum khule aam internet pe critisice karte hai.

Ab aisa nahi hai ki Hindi commentary ke aate hi logo ko woh pasand nahi aayi thi, Infact in the early 2000s , upon introducing the Hindi Commentary haamre kafi achche commentators the. Jaise agar mereko kuch obvious names lene ho toh → Ravi Shastri | Arun Lal | Sushil Doshi aur Maninder SIngh jaise kuch yaadgar commentators is indstry ka hissa reh chuke hai. Na keval unki style of commentary English wali se kafi similar tha, balki unki field placement ko samjhane ka tairka + bowling plans ka discussion sabhi viewers ko kafi pasand tha.

https://www.moneycontrol.com/sports/cricket/ipl/we-will-work-on-it-harbh ajan-singh-responds-to-criticism-of-hindi-commentary-in-ipl-2025-article- 12976553.html/amp?utm_source=chatgpt.com But phir entry hoti hai is pure chaos ki main villain “IPL” ki. Aur IPL ke entry hote hi entertainment se lekar Commentary ko puri tairke se change kar diya jaata hai ! Yes I repeat puri tarike se !

Aur yeh kehna galat nahi hoga ki Hindi commentary ko lekar jo ekdum se internet se aayi hai usme bas 2 cheeje involve hai. Ek Navjot Singh SIdhu , aur dusra IPL !

Arrival Of Hindi Commentary IPL ke cricket mein aate hi cricket cricket nahi raha tha !

Woh ek enterntainment , drama aur cheejo ko promote karne ka sabse asaan raasta ban chuka tha. Aur yahi pe Broadcasters ek baat samajh chuke the → Ki Hindi commentary ek large mass audience ko attract krte hai. Aur aisa ho bhi kyu na....Hindi commentary ke aate hi majority of the Indian cricket fans were watching the Hindi Commentary.

Toh hona kya tha?

Dekhte hi dekhte Hindi commentary ka style puri tarike se change ho gya.

metadata.title: Hindi Broadcast Commentary Script
metadata.text:
Typical analysis se Entertainment , jokes , punchlines ,aur shyariyo mein commentary shift ho chuki thi. Kyuki ab Broadcasters ko cricket se jyada uske entertainment se matlab tha. Isliye Hindi commentsary woh ban gayi jise aaj hum sunte hai.

Last Chapter : Why is Hindi Commentary Criticized??

Hindi Commentary ko lekar aaj jo hum criticism dekhte hai woh koi random criticism nahi hai. Balki iske pure 5 major factors hai jiski vajah se Hindi Commentary is getting rotten.

1) Overuse of Slang , shayari and wordplay Hindi commentary ko lekar jo complaint sabse jayda dikhti hai woh hai commentary choodke baki sab bol dena. Jaise koi cricket match nahi balki koi shayri muishara chal raha ho. Jisme sabse jyada critiscice kara jata hai former Indian opener “Navjot SIngh Sidhu”. Jitne Navjot singh siddhu ne apne career mein run nahi banaye hai usse jyada toh unhe social media platform pe apni commentary ke liye galiyan pad chuki hai.

"Gharwali ki tarah pitch ka mood badal sakta hai." "Ball lagi Ram ko, ghayal hua Shyam." Yeh kuch phrases hai jo aksar Sidhu apni commentary mein use kar dete hai.

Ab in baato ka cricket se toh choodo ek normal context se bhi koi naata nahi hai. Yeh baate ek-2 baar viewer sehen kar sakta hai but aisi baate hi jab commentary ban jaye toh us commentator aur style ka kuch nahi ho sakta .

Aur yeh ek baar nahi hai , balki pichle IPL ke dauran jab Sidhu ne commentary mein vapsi ki thi toh show ki TRP aur broadcasters ki vajah se unhone aisi commentary kari ki unhe pure season criticism jhelna pada. Aur yeh baat sab sirf Sidhu pe aake nahi khadi ho jati.

Aakash Chopra → Jo ki Hindi commentary ke best commentator maane jaate hai, kabhi kabhi especially ek highstake IPL matches mein kuch aise slogans , wordplay aur poetic lines boldete hai jiska koi sense nahi banata hai.

“Andre andar gend bahar”......

Yeh toh bas kuch examples hai.

2) Reduced Technical Analysis Ab jab commentary bigad hi gayi hai toh jo cheez Hindi commentary mein pehle jaan bhar deti thi woh thi cricket ko leke analysis. Maano ya maano jitna ek cricket fan cricket ko dekhkar us sport ko utna nahi samajhta hai balki commentary sun sun ke samajh jaata hai. But jab commentary asisi jho rahi ho toh analysis toh choodo , cricket ki normal baat ho jaye toh bhi bohot badi baat hogi. Jaise pehle ke samay mein bowler ke bowling changes se lekar captain ke mindset ki baate hoti thi, aaj vahi sab jokes aur one liner pe aake reh gaye hai. IPL 2025 ke dauran hindi commentary ko lekar debate bhi online tabhi shuru hui thi jab ek fan unke commentary mein kari hui analysis pe sawaal utha diye the.

But lekin Hindi commentators analysis kar dete toh shayad unke broadcasters ki reach woh numbers provide nahi pati jo tab kar rahi thi.

metadata.title: Hindi Broadcast Commentary Script
metadata.text:
3) Personal Bias and Narrative Building Ab yeh jo teesra point hai , this might bhi very controversial to u all , but jo hamne past mein witness kiya hai mein woh usi ke absis pe bata rha hu. Agar mein aapse puchu ki english commentary aur hindi commentary major kya farak hai toh aap sabhi log → Analysis aur Jokes wala point bol doge , which is absolutely true. But jo cheez uske baad aati hai woh hai “Commentators ka personal agenda aur unka narrative building” . Past mein aise kai instances hue hai jaha pe hame hindi commentators ka bias kafi jyada saaf saaf dekhne ko mila hai rather than english commentators… Aur isme sabse bada example hai “Ambati rayadu” !

Vasie Ambati Rayadu jyada kuch commentary mein biasness dikhate nahi hai lekin jab unki ex IPL team , CSK ki hoti hai toh woh apni biasness towards csk rok nahi pate hai. Aapko woh 2024 mein RCB vs CSK ka iconic virtual knockout match toh yaad hi hoga , jaha pe RCB ne CSK ko desried marjin se harane ke baad playoffs mein jagah bana li thi. Us Match mein bhi saaf saaf Rayadu ki biasness dilkh rahi thi kki woh bilkul bhi kush nahi the ki CSK woh match haar rahi ho.

Lekin yaha pe ek important sawaal uthta hai.

Kya Hindi commentary hamesha se aisi hi thi? Kya shuru se hi Hindi commentary ka focus cricket se jyada dialogues, shayari aur entertainment par tha? Sach kahu toh nahi. Agar hum thoda peeche jaakar dekhe, especially early 2000s ke time par, toh Hindi commentary ka format kaafi alag tha. Us waqt commentary ka main kaam hota tha viewer ko match ka context samjhana. Pitch ka behaviour kya hai, bowler ka plan kya hai, batsman kis strategy se khel raha hai — yeh sab cheeze properly discuss hoti thi. Arun Lal jaise commentators Hindi commentary box mein hote the toh woh calmly field placements explain karte the. Maninder Singh spin bowling ke angles aur variations par baat karte the. Ravi Shastri jab Hindi mein bolte the toh unka tone bhi analytical hi hota tha. Matlab language Hindi thi…lekin content pure cricket ka hota tha. Isliye agar aaj koi yeh bole ki Hindi commentary hamesha se kharab thi, toh woh completely sahi baat nahi hai. Problem language mein kabhi nahi thi…problem dheere dheere commentary ke style change hone mein thi.

Aur shayad sabse important baat bhi yahi hai ki problem Hindi language nahi hai. Problem commentary ka format hai. Agar aap dhyaan se dekho toh Hindi commentators jab TV commentary se bahar YouTube shows ya analysis videos karte hai, tab woh kaafi solid cricket breakdown dete hai. Aakash Chopra ke YouTube analysis videos ho ya Vivek Razdan ke tactical discussions — waha par pitch conditions, bowling plans aur match situations sab explain kiye jaate hai. Matlab clearly cricket knowledge ki koi kami nahi hai. Lekin jab wahi log live broadcast commentary box mein baithte hai, tab unhe ek aisa format follow karna padta hai jaha entertainment ko zyada importance di jaati hai. Aur yaha par broadcasters ka role bhi aata hai. Hindi commentary actually duniya ka sabse zyada watched cricket commentary feed hai, isliye broadcasters usse aise design karte hai ki woh maximum audience ko engage kare — especially casual viewers ko jo detailed analysis se zyada excitement aur reactions dekhna pasand karte hai. Toh agar honestly dekha jaye toh yeh Hindi vs English ka debate utna simple nahi hai jitna internet par lagta hai.

metadata.title: Hindi Broadcast Commentary Script
metadata.text:
Real debate actually analysis vs entertainment ka hai. Aur jab tak commentary ka focus cricket ko explain karne se zyada viral moments aur punchlines banane par rahega, tab tak Hindi commentary par criticism aata rahega.

metadata.title: How West Indies Won the 2016 T20 World Cup: Remember the Name
metadata.text:
INTRODUCTION

Saal 2016 , ek aisa saal jise hum Indian fans kafi cheejo ke liye yaad rakhte , phir chahe woh Virat Kohli ka over the top form ho, ya phir India ka tests mein no1 banna . Lekin woh saal jitna hamari Indian team ke liye khaas tha, usse 1000x guna jyada ek dusri team ke liye woh special tha………..”The Mighty West Indies” [clips of west indies playing 2016 t20 worldcup + clips of winning the U18 world cup + womens world cup] Ek aisi team jisme ek se badhkar ek players bhare hue the , ek aisi team jisne na keval mens t20 world cup ko jeeta balki U18 world cup aur womens world cup ko bhi jeeta tha. Jaha pe koi bhi team ek t20 world cup jeetne mein apni jee jaan laga deti hai, vahi in that year West Indies won 3/3………….Aur isme sabse maze ki baat yeh hai ki kisi bhi 3 tournaments mein West Indies favourites tak nahi thi….espeacially in 2016 MENS T20 WORLD CUP !

Isliye aaj ki is video mein hum yahi dekhege ki kaise na keval West Indies ne apna dusra t20 world cup jeeta , balki aisa kuch kar diya jise aaj bhi hum cricket fans use ek iconic world cup campaign ki tarah dekhte hai.

CH1 : Pre world cup scenario Agar ek normal team ki baat kare toh kisi bhi bade ICC tournament se pehle pura cricket board aur management player selection se leke complete preparation mein involve ho jate hai kyuki obviously T20 cricket ka sabse bada taaj aakhir kon nahi pehna chahega….lekin aisa kuch West Indies ke saath nahi tha. Infact is T20World cup se pehle West Indies ko favourite tak consider nahi kara jaa raha tha. Jaha pe baaki teams apni preparations kar rahi thi vahi pe West indies cricket team mein apne alag hi internal conflicts chal rahe the unke board se. Phir chahe woh unfair committee selections ko lekar ko ya phir players ke unfair pay ko lekar. Puri west Indies team bikhar chuki thi and even 2014 ke beech India tour mein West Indies ke star players like Pollard and Andre Russel already beech tour chood chuke the. Isliye jab yeh West Indies team 2016 ka t20wc khelne utri toh kisi ne bhi nahi socha tha ki yeh team semi finals tak bhi jaa sakti hai. And phir jo uske baad hua woh batata hai kyu West Indies ki team ek actual world champion thi.… Ab agar thoda sa detail mein dekhe toh West Indies ki preparation bilkul normal nahi thi. Jaha baaki teams centralized camps, fixed combinations aur long-term planning pe kaam kar rahi thi, wahi West Indies ke players zyada tar alag-alag T20 leagues khelkar aa rahe the. Chris Gayle, Andre Russell, Pollard, Bravo — yeh sab players saal bhar IPL, CPL, BBL jaise tournaments mein pressure situations khel chuke the. Matlab jab baaki teams T20 ko abhi bhi “shorter version of ODI” jaise treat kar rahi thi, West Indies ke players ke liye T20 ek separate format tha, jisme risk lena, six maarna aur fail hona normal tha.

Aur yahi difference unke preparation ka sabse bada advantage banke gaya.

metadata.title: How West Indies Won the 2016 T20 World Cup: Remember the Name
metadata.text:
Chris Gayle , Andre Russel , Kieron Pollard or Sunil Narine aise players hai jo na keval IPL mein apni apni teams mein dominate karte hai balki yeh aaj bhi franchise league cricket mein greatest consider kare jaa sakte hai. West Indies ke players ko pata tha ki unka selection average ya consistency pe nahi, balki impact pe hone wala hai. West Indies ke batsman ko average ka dar nahi tha infact all the players were ahead of their time in t20 cricket. Jaisi hard hitting approach aajkal t20 mein aa gayi hai….vaisi mentality and approach woh players pehle se hi 2016 mein leke aa gaye the. Aur T20 cricket mein jab darr nikal jaata hai, tab batting dangerous ho jaati hai.

CH2 : Squad, Strengths aur Weaknesses Agar 2016 West Indies squad ko paper pe dekha jaaye, toh kaafi logon ko lagta tha ki yeh team unstable hai. Top order unpredictable, bowling thodi inconsistent, aur fielding bhi kabhi kabhi average. Lekin jo cheez paper pe weakness lag rahi thi, wahi ground pe unki strength ban gayi. Team ke paas batting depth thi No. 8 tak. Gayle, Simmons, Samuels, Russell, Pollard, Bravo — matlab kisi bhi over mein match palat sakta tha.

Bowling mein bhi unka approach simple thi. Sunil Narine aur Samuel Badree jaise spinners middle overs mein run rokte the, jabki Andre Russell aur Bravo death overs specialist the. Us puri squad mein Sabse important cheez thi role clarity. Jaha pe Chris Gayle first ball se pura momentum West Indies ki taraf shift kar dete the vahi pe Simmons Innings ko hold krte the , and jaisa hamne is T20 world cup mein dekha tha. Samuels pressure situations handle karta tha. Russell aur Pollard finishers the. Bravo all-rounder role mein captaincy support karta tha. Kisi ko extra sochna nahi padta tha. Sabko pata tha ki unka kaam kya hai.

CH3 : Group Stages – Statement Cricket West Indies ka group bilkul bhi easy nahi tha. Group 1 mein unke saath England, South Africa, Sri Lanka aur Afghanistan jaise teams thi. Matlab ek taraf power-packed England, doosri taraf South Africa jaisi disciplined side, aur saath mein defending champions Sri Lanka. Agar yeh group cross ho jaata, tabhi koi team knockouts ke baare mein soch sakti thi. Aur yahin se West Indies ka actual test shuru hota hai.

Tournament ka pehla hi match tha 16 March 2016, England ke against, Mumbai ke Wankhede Stadium mein tha. England ne pehle batting karte hue 182 runs bana diye, jo us time ek strong total maana jaa raha tha. Lekin chase mein jo hua, woh sirf ek successful run chase nahi tha, woh ek mindset reveal tha. Chris Gayle ne 48 balls mein 100 run bana diye. 11 chhakke, 5 chauke, strike rate 208+. Yeh century sirf scorecard ka part nahi thi, yeh ek clear message thi jaha pe England bilkul helpless ban chuke the. Gayle ne fast bowlers ko bhi same intent se maara, spinners ko bhi, aur powerplay ke har ek over ko use kiya. West Indies ne target 18.1 overs mein chase kar liya. Us din ke baad yeh clear ho gaya ki agar West Indies ko 160–170 ke score pe rokhne ki soch rahe ho, toh woh kaafi nahi hone wala.

metadata.title: How West Indies Won the 2016 T20 World Cup: Remember the Name
metadata.text:
Is match ke baad bhi kai logon ne kaha ki yeh ek “Gayle special” tha. Lekin agla match South Africa ke against, 20 March 2016, Nagpur mein, yeh prove karta hai ki West Indies sirf batting pe depend nahi kar rahi thi. Is match mein West Indies pehle batting karte hue sirf 138 runs bana paayi. Normally yeh score knockout type game mein defend karna mushkil hota hai. Lekin yahin pe unka bowling aur planning ka side saamne aata hai. Sunil Narine aur Samuel Badree ne powerplay aur middle overs mein South Africa ko bilkul free nahi hone diya. AB de Villiers sirf 6 run bana paaye, aur puri South Africa team 122 pe all out ho gayi. West Indies ne match 8 run se jeet liya. Yeh match unki tournament journey ka turning point tha, kyunki yahin se yeh samajh aa gaya tha ki yeh team sirf maarne nahi, match close karna bhi jaanti hai.

And isi same fashion mein west indies ne apna agla match Sri Lanka ke khilaf 7 wickets se jee liya.

Halanki West Indies apna last match Afghanistan se ek thriller fashion mein haar liya but already West Indies semis ke liye asaani se qualify kar chuki thi.

CH4 : Semi-final vs India – Mindset ka Farq Semi-final India ke against tha, aur honestly yahi woh match tha jaha poori duniya ki nazar West Indies pe tik gayi. Venue Eden Gardens tha, stadium completely packed, crowd almost pura one-sided, aur upar se India tournament mein unbeaten chal rahi thi. India ne pehle batting karte hue 192 ka score khada kar diya, jo us time ke T20 standards ke hisaab se ek kaafi bada total maana jaata tha. Isliye normally yaha pe chasing team thodi conservative approach leti hai, kyunki early wickets gaye toh match haath se nikal sakta hai, lekin West Indies ke saath aisa kuch nahi hua.

Use pure chase ke dauran west indies ke saath jo cheez thi woh thi unki kismat. Lendl Simmons us puri chase mein sabse important part bane rahe the , lekin hum sabhi ko pata hai ki un Lendl Simmons ko ek nahi do nahi balki 3-3 baar ek lifeline mili thi jab Ashwin , Bumrah ki no balls pe woh out ho gaye the but unhe not out decalre kar diya gaya tha.. aur yahi moment match ka turning point ban jaata hai. Uske baad Simmons aur zyada freely bat karte hain, kyunki unhone scorecard ke pressure ko ignore karke sirf gaps aur boundary options pe focus kiya.

Yahin par India thoda defensive ho jaati hai, kyunki bowling mein variations miss hone lagti hain, aur death overs ke liye clear planning nazar nahi aati.

Slower balls aur wide yorkers ka execution inconsistent raha, aur field placements bhi thode reactive lagne lage. Iska result yeh hua ki momentum dheere dheere West Indies ke side shift ho gaya, aur India ke paas comeback ka time kam hota chala gaya.

CH5 : Final vs England – Formula ka Peak Final mein England ke saamne phir se West Indies thi. England ne pehle batting karte hue 155 ka score banaya, jo final ke pressure ke hisaab se defendable lag raha tha. West Indies ke liye chase easy nahi tha. Early wickets gire, run rate manageable tha, lekin pressure constantly build ho raha tha.

Yaha pe Marlon Samuels ka role crucial tha. Samuels flashy nahi khele, unhone smart cricket khela. Bowlers ko target kiya, gaps nikale, aur strike rotate ki. Aur phir aata hai woh moment jise shayad koi bhi cricket fan bhool nahi sakta — Carlos Brathwaite ke woh 4 sixes.

metadata.title: How West Indies Won the 2016 T20 World Cup: Remember the Name
metadata.text:
Yeh sirf ek over nahi tha. Yeh West Indies ke poore T20 philosophy ka summary tha. Last over mein risk lena, fear ko side mein rakhna, aur apni strength pe pura trust rakhna. Ben Stokes jaise bowler ke against bhi hesitation nahi thi. Aur jab woh last ball six boundary ke paar gayi, tab sirf ek match nahi jeeta gaya — ek era define hua.

CH6 : Legacy 2016 ke baad T20 cricket badal gaya. Teams ne realize kiya ki strike rate, intent aur depth zyada important hai. West Indies pehli team bani jo do baar T20 World Cup jeeti. Aur sirf men’s nahi — women’s aur U19 titles bhi jeete gaye.

Yeh world cup sirf trophies ka nahi tha, yeh approach ka world cup tha. West Indies ne dikhaya ki T20 cricket ka future fearless hai. Aur shayad isliye, 2016 ka T20 World Cup aaj bhi sirf ek tournament nahi, balki ek iconic cricketing memory ban chuka hai.

metadata.title: The Controversial Life of Navjot Singh Sidhu
metadata.text:
NAVJOT SINGH SIDDHU

v

INTRODUCTION

Cricket history mein kai naam aise hai joki records ke saath likhe jaate hai, jaise Rohit Sharma ke 3 double 100s , Virat ke fastest 10k ODI runs aur ya phir Sachin Tendulkar ka anginat records. But jaha pe ek taraf cricket legends pe baat unke cricketing career ke upar ki jaati hai, vahi pe kuch cricketers aate hai jinki baat sirf controversies mein kari jaati hai. Jinme se aaj ham baat karne wale hai India ke former opener , ek massive six hitter and abhi ke cricket commentator “Navjot Singh Siddhu” ki. Ek aise cricketer jinki shuruwaat toh hui thi ek massive set back lekin dekhte hi dekhte na keval unhone Indian cricket mein six hitting ka culture shuru kia balki usi ke dauran woh aisi aisi controveries mein pade jinki actual ginti shayad kisi ko pata hi nahi hai. Phir chahe woh unka khudka cricket career ko ya phir retirement ke baad ki unki TV Life. Apne international career mein Jail jaane se lekar Cricket ke baad bhi controversies mein kai baar Siddhu ka naam aya hai. Aur aaj ki is video mein hum Navjot Singh Siddhu ki isi controversial life ko dekhege ki jo player ek time pe Sachin Tendulkar ke world cup mein opening partner the, woh 2025 aate aate ek ke baad ek controveries mein phase chuke hai.

metadata.title: The Under-19 World Cup: Crucible of Legends
metadata.text:
The class of 2018 U19 World Cup

Intro:

Generational !

Agar aap koi bhi sport consume karte ho toh aapne kai baar fans ko kafi jyada talented players ko is “Generational” ka tag dete hue suna hi hoga. Phir chahe woh unka favourite player ho , ya phir ek aisa player jo ki kaafi kam samay pe kafi kuch achieve kar chuka ho us sports mein. And baaki saare sports ki tarah , yeh baat ham sabke ke favourite sports CRICKET mein bhi lagu hoti hai .Cricket mein koi bhi International team kitna dominate karegi, kitni legacy banaegi, ya phir kitni glory achieve karegi, yeh baat na toh Players ke experience pe solely depend karti hai, aur na hi us team ka environement kaisa hai. But jis cheez pe dominance sabse jyada depend karti hai, woh hai “The Amount of Generational Players that the team has” !

Aur agar hum baat kare aaj ki Team India ki , toh the list goes on and on……[Pics of Kohli , Pujara , Rahane , Rohit] Pichle 25 saalo mein jitne generational talents team India se nikle hai utne shayad hi kisi aur desh se nikle ho. Virat Kohli , Mohammed Kaif , Rohit Sharma , Shikhar Dhawan , Ishant Sharma are the examples. But kya ho ki mein aapse kahu ki in sabhi generational talents mein ek cheej common thi.

Yeh sabhi players Indian team mein apne U19 world cup ke performance ki vajah se hue the. Unhone jitna tagda u19 wc mein perform kara, main team mein select ho jane ke baad vaisa hi performance zaari rakha. Is system se India ne kafi jyada players nikale hai, phir chahe woh 2000 U19 WC ke youngsters ho, ya phir 2008 U19 WC ke. But the truth is, no world cup youngsters come close to the “Class of 2018” !

Chapter 0 Ab maano ya na maano , jitna talent hume 2018 ke U19 world cup mein dekhne ko mila tha, utna shayad hi hame kisi aur U19 world cup mein dekhne ko mila ho. That world cup was not only special but hamari generation mein woh ek lauta world cup tha jisse India mein U19 cricket ko lekar craze badha tha. Jabse U19 world cups cricket history mein shuru hue hai, tabse lekar ab tak hame har world cup se 1-2 talented players dekhne ko mil hi jaate hai. Phir chahe woh 2000 ke world cup ke Yuvraj Singh , 2004 U19 world cup se Shikhar Dhawan aur ya phir 2008 ke U19 world cup se khud King Kohli ho.

But 2018 ke U19 world cup se, there was not only one or two players , it was the whole team ! Shubman Gill se lekar Abhishek Sharma tak , sabhi ke sabhi players us team mein na hi keval talented the, balki jis hisab se un players ne us world cup mein one sided dominate kara tha, aisa lag hi nahi raha tha ki woh team koi competition bhi face kar rahi hai. Pichle 2-3 saalo mein jaha pe ek taraf team India har format mein kafi achcha kar rahi hai, vahi pe Shubman Gill , Abhishek sharma aur Arshdeep singh (jo ki 2018 wc batch ka part the) iska reason bataye jaate hai. Lekin us 2018 U19 WC ki Iconic Team India ko Iconic banane ki shuruaat 2017 se hi ho chuki thi, under the “WALL OF INDIA” .

metadata.title: The Under-19 World Cup: Crucible of Legends
metadata.text:
CHAPTER 1 – The Rahul Dravid Factor 14 February 2016, India 2016 ka U19 world cup ek humiliating way mein West Indies se haar jati hai. Pure tournament ko dominate karne ke baad India falls short against the mighty west Indians. But isme shocking baat yeh hai ki is final mein bhi kai Indian talents part le rahe the. Jaise Rishabh Pant , Khud Captain Ishan Kishan aur Sarfaraz Khan, But itne sab talented khiladi hone ke bawajood West Indies tear apart India aur 5 wicket se woh final and woh world cup apne naam kar leti hai. Us Loss se na keval BCCI ko ek bada jhatka lagta hai balki unhe bhi samajh saata hai ki U19 world cups keval ek trophy hunt tournament nahi hai. Lekin ek aisa stage hai jaha pe young Indian prodijies se best nikalwake India ko ek upcoming superstar de sakte hai. Aur yaha pe entry hoti hai us insaan ki jo ki na keval India ko unki history ke best youngsters dene wala tha balki us puri U19 team mein ek aisi philosophy jaari karne wala tha jaha pe India ka future aur bhi jyada bright hone wala tha…… Rahul Dravid !

508 International Matches 24 hazar se jyada international runs aur 48 shatak ! Dravid na keval India ke one of the best players mein se jo already India ko kai baar match jitwa chuke hai , balki woh India ke one of the most experienced player bhi hai. Toh in young bloods ko train karni ki zimedaari ab bhala Rahul Dravid se better kon kar sakta tha.

Aur yahi pe aati hai unki u19 players ko lekar unki philosophy….

Ab yeh saaf saaf clear toh tha ki ab India ko consistently matches jeetne padege but for Rahul Dravid it was never about results…unka clear cut maan na tha ki Players ko rather than making them focus on results…jitna unhe competitive stages pe experience milega utna unke liye benefitial hai. Be it a loss or be it a win….Squad ke har ek player ko rotation mein use kara jaaega aur sabhi players apna best dena hoga.

So the message was clear : ‘Winning the World Cup is important, but becoming future-ready is everything.’ Aur isi sab ko Dravid ne apne us campaign ke dauran ek interview mein bhi bataya hai.

Lekin kise pata tha ki yeh experience oriented approach India ko unka most dominant U19 world cup campaign de degi.

Chapter 2 : The Tournament of Domination (Visuals: Match highlights, Gill’s elegant drives, Shaw’s captaincy, Nagarkoti & Mavi’s express pace, Kalra’s heroics) January 2018 | New Zealand Pura cricketing world Newzealand mein aajta hai toh win one single trophy , one single cup !

Ab bas yaha se 16 teams aur 48 matches ka intezaar tha untill hame ek naya U19 World champion milti.

Aur INDIA ko is tournament ko dominate karne ki journey shuru hoti hai 14 January 2018 ko jab woh apne pehle hi match mein Australia u19 ko face karte hai. Us Match mein India ke future stars like Shubman Gill , Abhishek Sharma , Pirthwi Shaw , Kamlesh Nagarkoti aur us tournament ke best batsman and bowler Manjot Kalra aur Anukul roy bhi khel rahe the. Toh is playing Xi se aap andaza laga sakte ho ki us match ka kya haal raha hoga.

metadata.title: The Under-19 World Cup: Crucible of Legends
metadata.text:
India toss jeet ti hai aur batting karne ka decide karti hai. Aur pehli ball se hame dikh jata hai ki Rahul Dravid ke players kitne jyada fearless ban chuke hai. Sabse pehle Pirthwi Shaw and Manjot Kalra ki 180 runs ki opening partnership….phir Shubman Gill ki lagai gai ek quick 50 aur score 328 tak jaa chuka tha. Iske jawab mein chase karne aayi Australia na keval humilate hui balki sapne 42.5 overs mein all out hoke us match 100 runs se haar gayi !

Kise ne bhi nahi socha tha ki jo team last u19 wc tak hardly 300 score kar paa rahi thi woh opening match mein 328 score kar degi. Is match ke highest wicket taker bante hai Kamlesh Nagarkoti and Shivam Mavi , jo ki 3-3 wickets lete hai.

Bas phir kya tha…next match mein ZImbabwe ko 1st innings mein 117 pe all out aur next match Papa new guinea ko mahez 64 pe all out kar India apne dono matches comfortably jeet jati hai aur table ke top pe jagah bana leti hai.

But tab tak title confirm nahi tha kyuki abhi knockouts aane baaki the and ham sabhi ko pata hai ki decade mein India ka knockouts mein kya haal chal raha tha phir chahe woh Mens ki senior team ho ya phir U19 wali team…..

Lekin aisa hua hota toh shayad hum aaj us dominating campaign pe video na bana rahe hote.

India ka Quarter Final match tha against Bangladesh.

Ab woh match apna aap mein itna kuch khaas nahi tha, infact India ne to us comfortably 71 runs se jeetkar apni jagah Semi finals mein bana li thi. But jo cheez mazedaar thi woh thi Shubman Gill ki 102 runs ki ek not out paari aur woh unki is tournament ki pehli century thi.

But lekin phir aata hai is pure world cup ka sabse anticipated match, the eternal rivalry INDIA VS PAKISTAN !

Aur keval koi aisa vaisa match nahi balki is tournament ka semi final tha. Yaani agar India haari toh na keval unhe Pakistan se haar ka backlash face karna padega balki woh is world cup se bhi bahar ho jaegi.

Pakistan toss jeeti ti hai aur India ko ek difficult surface pe India ko batting karne ka invitation deti hai. Lekin us difficult surface pe Gill tab bhi khade rehte hai aur ek aur brilliant century banate hai. Jaha pe ek taraf India wickets kho rahi thi collapse ho raha tha, vahi pe Gill us puri inning ke backbone banke khade ho gaye the. Aur usi ke badaluat India 273 ka target Pakistan de pai.

And phir jo hame India ke bowlers masterclass dekhne ko mili hai woh honestly kisi ne bhi expect kara tha…be it fans or commentators… Ishan Porel aur Shivam Mavi jahe pe ek taraf starting mein Pakistan ko pareshan karte hai vahi pe dusri taraf Anukul roy aur Shiva Singh Pakistan ke wickets lene lag jaate hai. Pakistan ki batting ka settle hona toh choodo, Pakistan keval 69 runs pe hi all out ho jati hai aur India 203 runs se is match ko jeet jati hai.

metadata.title: The Under-19 World Cup: Crucible of Legends
metadata.text:
THE FINAL !

Ab finally woh time aa jata hai jiske liye puri Indian team and Rahul Dravid ne mahino se mehnat ki thi. World Cup ka Final!

Aur woh us world cup ki one of the competitive team Australia ke khilaf.

Halanki India Australia ko ek baar group stages mein ek taraf hara chuki thi lekin Finals ka pressure kuch aur hi hota hai (jo ki 2023 wc mein dekh chuke the)....Aur sabhi fans ki dua thi ki India ab finals mein aake toh choke na kar jaye.

Australia toss jeet ti hai aur pehle batting karne ka decide karna ka galat decision le leti hai. Kyuki jaha pe ek taraf woh pitch puri dry thi, vahi pe dusri taraf open cracks ki vajah se jis tarah Shivam Mavi Aussies ko pareshan karte hai woh dekhne layak tha. Shivam Mavi 3 wickets lete hai aur Australia mahex 216 pe all out ho jati hai. And phir begin hoti hai India ki chase ya phir aisa kaho ki Manjot Kalra ki chase ……… Prithwi Shaw ka wicket 71 pe khone ke baad Gill bhi 30 runs banake out ho jate hai lekin ek bhi baar aisa nahi lagta hai ki India might lose the match kyuki end ke dusre side khade the Manjot kalra jo ki ek ke baad ek boundires lagate jaa rahe the……MANJOT KALRA us match mein notout 101 banate hai aur woh Match and world cup India ek dominating tarike se jeet jati hai !!!!!!!!!!!

Is world cup ke top scorer the Shubman Gill jo ki aaj na keval Indian team ke test and odi captain hai balki modern cricket ka ek impt part ban chuke hai.

Highest Wicket taker the Anukul roy with 14 wickets..

Us squad ki sabse khaas baat yeh thi ki us squad ke average playes bhi aaj T20I ke leading wicket taker for India [arshdeep] aur t20 ke ek ke baad ek records tod rahe hai..[Abhishek]........................

Ab maano ya na maano cricket ne Prime West Indies se lekar Prime Australia tak sab dekha hai. Jinhone ICC trophies aur bilateral series ko jeetna ek normal routine ki tarah bana liya tha. And un sabhi teams mein generational players bhare pade hue the.
